reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that prepares Android build toolchains and automates Gradle assembly to produce APK files, with workspace downloads, configuration writes, and build execution.

summaries.zh: 自动准备 Android 构建工具链并运行 Gradle，将 Android 项目构建为 APK 文件。
summaries.en: Automatically prepares the Android build toolchain and runs Gradle to build an Android project into APK files.

capabilities: Downloads JDK, Android SDK, Gradle, and related dependencies
Writes build configuration and caches to workspace directories
Copies generated APK files to an output directory
